name: Compliance
strapline: Know your obligations. Stay in control.
description: Clarity on the legal, regulatory and contractual obligations that apply to you, and a practical system to keep them assigned, evidenced and monitored.

solutions.name: Compliance Health Check
solutions.tagline: Assess how obligations are identified, assigned, evidenced, monitored and reported.
solutions.summary: An independent review of your compliance arrangements that confirms what applies to you, who owns it and whether you can demonstrate compliance when asked.
whoItIsFor: Organisations in regulated or licensed activities.
Businesses unsure whether all obligations are known and owned.
Management teams preparing for inspections, audits or due diligence.
whatWeAssess: The compliance universe: laws, regulations, licences and contracts
Ownership and accountability for each obligation
Compliance reporting and escalation of breaches
outcomes: A compliance register tailored to your organisation
A compliance calendar with owners and due dates
Monitoring and reporting routines that are easy to sustain

faq.question: What is a compliance register?
faq.answer: A single list of the laws, regulations, licences, permits and contractual obligations that apply to your organisation, each with an owner, the evidence held and a monitoring frequency.

faq.question: Which obligations does the compliance health check cover?
faq.answer: Company law, tax, employment, data protection, licensing and sector regulation applicable in Mauritius, together with key contractual commitments to customers, lenders and landlords.

faq.question: How do we keep compliance up to date after the review?
faq.answer: With a compliance calendar of recurring deadlines, named owners, a periodic monitoring check and a short compliance report to management or the board.
